about: Namesakes split by hand: the tree joins people by name, so these are kept apart section by section (see annotate/merge.py, apply_namesakes).

groups.name: Menoetius, son of Iapetus
groups.about: Titan, son of Iapetus and Asia, hurled to Tartarus by Zeus

groups.name: Menoetius, father of Patroclus
groups.about: son of Actor and Aegina, father of Patroclus

groups.name: Stheneboea
groups.about: Lycian Stheneboea (Antia), daughter of Iobates and wife of Proetus, who falsely accuses Bellerophon.

groups.name: Stheneboea, daughter of Aphidas
groups.about: Arcadian Stheneboea, daughter of Aphidas and sister of Aleus, also named as a wife of Proetus.

groups.name: Lynceus
groups.about: Son of Egyptus, husband of Hypermnestra, spared by the Danaids and later king of Argos after Danaus.

groups.name: Lynceus, son of Aphareus
groups.about: Messenian son of Aphareus and brother of Idas, famed for his sharp sight and a hunter.

groups.name: Lycurgus
groups.about: Thracian king of the Edoni, son of Dryas, who expelled Dionysus.

groups.name: Lycurgus, king of Nemea
groups.about: Nemean king, husband of Eurydice and father of Opheltes.

groups.name: Lycurgus, son of Aleus
groups.about: Arcadian son of Aleus, father of Ancaeus, Epochus, Amphidamas and Iasus.

groups.name: Niobe
groups.about: Wife of Amphion and daughter of Tantalus, queen of Thebes who boasted of her children, whose children Apollo and Artemis killed.

groups.name: Niobe, daughter of Phoroneus
groups.about: Argive Niobe, the first mortal woman loved by Zeus, mother of Argus and Pelasgus.

groups.name: Antigone
groups.about: Daughter of Oedipus and Jocasta; accompanies her father and buries her brother Polynices.

groups.name: Antigone, daughter of Eurytion
groups.about: Daughter of Eurytion and first wife of Peleus; a separate character from Oedipus' daughter.

groups.name: Megapenthes
groups.about: Son of Proetus, born to him and later king of Argos.

groups.name: Megapenthes, son of Menelaus
groups.about: Son of Menelaus by a slave woman.

groups.name: Erichthonius
groups.about: Trojan king, son of Dardanus and father of Tros, rich in horses (the Dardanian king matched by Wikipedia).

groups.name: Erichthonius, king of Athens
groups.about: Earth-born king of Athens, begotten of Hephaestus and the earth.

groups.name: Deucalion
groups.about: Son of Prometheus and husband of Pyrrha; survivor of the great flood.

groups.name: Deucalion, son of Minos
groups.about: Cretan Deucalion, son of Minos; father of Idomeneus and Molus (Apollodorus 3.3.1).
